title: Employee Relations: Roles and Responsibilities
overview: Although the various functions within Human Resources (HR) have evolved, Employee Relations (ER) remains somewhat ambiguous. ER professionals are tasked with administering operations, reporting on key performance indicators (KPIs), addressing grievances, enforcing policies, managing performance, handling internal communications, and promoting social events, among other responsibilities. This course aims to clarify the diverse activities associated with the employee relations function. Through comprehensive materials and resources, participants will enhance their understanding and engagement in the employee relations aspects of their organizations.
audience: his course is intended for individuals working in employee relations, human resources, or personnel and administration roles, whether directly or indirectly involved in providing support services to internal clients within their organization.
methodology: he course is structured into independent modules focusing on various aspects of the employee relations profession. Each module includes role-playing, group activities, and case studies to reinforce participants’ ability to apply their knowledge in real-world scenarios.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Define employee relations as a function and outline its primary roles within human resources
Manage employee records in compliance with local labor laws and regulations
Utilize appropriate Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to enhance attendance and reduce absenteeism
Implement objective methods for measuring and improving employee morale
Distinguish between employee dissatisfaction, complaints, and grievances, and determine when to classify an issue as a grievance and how to manage it effectively
